keyEvents.text: Goal! Oxford United 0, Stevenage 1. Carl Piergianni (Stevenage) header from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ben Broggio.
Tyler Goodrham (Oxford United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Carl Piergianni (Stevenage) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Saxon Earley (Stevenage) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Daniel Phillips (Stevenage) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
